QuestInfo.name: [Limina] White Mage
QuestInfo.0: You finally succeeded in defeating the #rBlack Mage#k. But... It seems you have vanished.
QuestInfo.1:
To your surprise, the #bWhite Mage#k appeared before you and spoke with you for a while. 
When you finally regained consciousness, you found yourself on the ship.
QuestInfo.2:
It seems you have revived for some reason,
much to Empress Cygnus's relief.
